notes.title: About the Language Issue
notes.content:
Hi steam community:

I have fixed the Language issue. 
MIDI RANGER will be run in English version if your OS's default language is not included in English/Chinese/Japanese.

If there is any issues related, you can leave a comment here. 


Hope you enjoy MIDI RANGER.

notes.title: MIDI RANGER Beta 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]MIDI RANGER Beta 1.0.4 Release Note[/h1]
Hi, steam community:

MIDI RANGER 1.0.4 has been updated on steam. In this version you can use "-rendermode" to render a high quality video. 

I made a tutorials of rendering:
[url=https://youtu.be/NhRsOzXJyWg]VIDEO LINK[/url]


You can leave feedback below.


Hope you enjoy MIDI RANGER.
